description: AeroVironment designs and manufactures unmanned aircraft systems for the U.S. military and allied forces. Its flagship Switchblade loitering munition — a backpack-portable kamikaze drone — achieved battlefield validation in Ukraine and anchors a $1.1 billion funded backlog. The company also makes tactical drones (JUMP-20, Raven, Puma) and acquired AI/sensor firm BlueHalo in 2024 to expand its software stack.
